glassLive: Liquid Glass · Live window sampling (wallpaper stays static)
barNames: Bar targets (advanced; use the control panel picker)
unified: Unified Appearance · Share palette, opacity, radius and border
reserveSpace: Behavior · Reserve space when always visible
groupWindows: Behavior · Group preview cells per application
effectMode.help: Native Blur uses ext-background-effect-v1 and Hyprland global decoration.blur; check Blur Status in the control panel. No local blur-strength slider. Liquid Glass keeps its independent shader settings.
barMode.help: Native Blur requires the compositor protocol and enabled global blur. Opacity 1 hides the effect; opacity 0 is transparent tint, not necessarily disabled blur. The control panel shows live settings and errors. Liquid Glass Bar remains experimental.
barGlassBackdrop: Bar Liquid Glass · Static P6 backdrop
barGlassBackdrop.help: Absolute path to a static P6 RGB bar crop. Requires the experimental Noctalia backend. This is not live Waywallen glass.
barGlassConvex: Bar Liquid Glass · Use ordinary rounded corners
barGlassConvex.help: Opt in to temporary convex corners. Existing concave settings are backed up and restored when leaving Liquid Glass.
barGlassOpacity.help: Independent of Bar background opacity and Unified Opacity. Suggested initial value: 85%; zero intentionally hides the material.
barGlassRefraction.help: Applies to the experimental GLES Bar material without restarting Noctalia.
barGlassBlur.help: Applies to the experimental GLES Bar material without restarting Noctalia.
barGlassDispersion.help: Applies to the experimental GLES Bar material without restarting Noctalia.
barGlassHighlight.help: Applies to the experimental GLES Bar material without restarting Noctalia.
barGlassTint.help: Applies to the experimental GLES Bar material without restarting Noctalia.
barGlassQuality.help: Low: 8 Gaussian samples. Balanced: 16. High: original 24. Changing quality recompiles only the material.
monitor.location: Choose Monitor in the MacDock control panel (Display dropdown). Auto, connected displays and All Monitors are available.
monitor.help: Stored preference. Use the detected-display dropdown in the MacDock control panel; manual editing is unnecessary.
